test_title: PYST 34: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Shortages**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Shortages is the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3. • **Shortages **mean a lack of something that is needed or desired. (किसी ऐसी चीज़ की कमी जिसकी आवश्यकता या इच्छा हो) • **Example**: *The company faced shortages of raw materials, which led to a decrease in production.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Fatigue **means extreme tiredness or exhaustion. (अत्यधिक थकान या थकावट) • **Failure **means a lack of success in achieving a goal or objective. (किसी लक्ष्य या उद्देश्य को प्राप्त करने में सफलता की कमी) • **Drought **means a prolonged period of abnormally low rainfall, leading to a shortage of water. (असामान्य रूप से कम वर्षा की लंबी अवधि, जिससे पानी की कमी हो गई) 4a:T83a, The correct answer is: **Frequent**.
